How we work, and work together.

Our values guide how we work to drive real-world impact, turning visionary ideas into systems that navigate highways and transform lives.

01.
Scientific

We embrace objectivity, act with integrity, and view leadership as what you bring to work every day.

02.
Curious

We ask hard questions, challenge our assumptions, and seek deeper understanding before answers.

03.
Diverse

We assume good intentions, encourage respectful discourse, and treat differences as essential, not optional.

04.
Resilient

We meet challenges with grit, creativity, and optimism – turning setbacks into breakthroughs.

05.
Accountable

We own our words and actions. We follow through on commitments andcommunicate changes openly.

06.
Safe

Safety is non-negotiable. Every decision and interaction strengthens the safety of our people, our product, and our world.

07.
Efficient

We work with focus and purpose, designing processes that favor reliability and efficiency over speed alone.

08.
Data Driven

We take calculated risks, validate with evidence, and act decisively. Data fuels conviction, conviction accelerates progress, and progress generates more data – creating a virtuous cycle of innovation.
